ValidationRule.description: This is to Prevent user from Changing Account owner and Type for the Prospect Account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName ='Prospect_Account',$Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Prevent_user_from_changing_Owner_Type__c = false ,$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - Freight', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - QCC', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - SND', OR(ISCHANGED(Type),ISCHANGED(OwnerId)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not entitled to change the Account owner and Type for the Prospect Account
